statement: theorem output_succ (V : Domain (E := E)) (α D : ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (t : ℕ) : output V α D loss x₁ p (t + 1) = if selected V α D loss x₁ p t = 0 then output V α D loss x₁ p t else BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.project V (output V α D loss x₁ p t - eta V α D loss x₁ p t • selected V α D loss x₁ p t)
